headword: {娯楽|ごらく}{小説|しょうせつ}

definitions.explanation: Fiction written primarily for enjoyment and entertainment rather than literary or artistic purposes. Encompasses genres such as mystery, romance, adventure, and science fiction.

examples.japanese: {娯楽|ごらく}{小説|しょうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{純文学|じゅんぶんがく}→純文学：13983_junbungaku⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{娯楽|ごらく}{小説|しょうせつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This author is better known for popular fiction than for literary novels.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧ (entertainment; amusement) and ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧ (novel). In Japanese literary discourse, fiction is traditionally divided into ⟦{純文学|じゅんぶんがく}→純文学：13983_junbungaku⟧ (literary fiction/serious literature) and {娯楽|ごらく}{小説|しょうせつ} (entertainment fiction). This distinction parallels but is not identical to the Western literary/genre fiction divide.

- {娯楽|ごらく}{小説|しょうせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write popular fiction
- {娯楽|ごらく}{小説|しょうせつ}⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧: popular fiction writer
- {娯楽|ごらく}{小説|しょうせつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{純文学|じゅんぶんがく}→純文学：13983_junbungaku⟧: popular fiction and literary fiction
